title: GTA 6's Jason Barely Talks. Rockstar Says Why
short_title: GTA 6's Jason barely talks. Here's why #GTA6 #Shorts
short_title_options: GTA 6's Jason barely talks. Here's why #GTA6 #Shorts
GTA 6's Jason was built on Steve McQueen #GTA6 #Shorts
Why GTA 6's Jason is so quiet (Rockstar) #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
Rockstar's senior vice president of narrative, Rupert Humphries, told Destructoid that Jason's quiet style comes from Steve McQueen in Sam Peckinpah's 1972 film The Getaway (McQueen "was famous for pulling lines out of scripts and saying things with his presence alone") and from research into Army veterans: "These guys typically aren't running their mouths." No story spoilers.

Sources: Destructoid, GamesRadar, PC Gamer (Nov 2026).

short_es.title: Jason de GTA 6 casi NO habla... y es a propósito 🤫 #GTA6 #Shorts
short_es.description: Rupert Humphries, vicepresidente de narrativa de Rockstar, le dijo a Destructoid que el estilo callado de Jason viene de Steve McQueen en The Getaway (1972), "famoso por quitar líneas de los guiones y decir las cosas solo con su presencia", y de investigar a veteranos del ejército: "estos tipos normalmente no andan hablando de más" (traducido). Sin spoilers.
